annotation.title_clean: מפמ"כ 395 – תחנות עבודה של רובוט תעשייתי: דרישות בטיחות
annotation.title_en: Israeli Standard SI 395 (1993): Robot Workstations – Safety Requirements
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The Standards Institution of Israel (מכון התקנים הישראלי)
annotation.summary_en: Israeli Standard SI 395 (1993) setting safety requirements for industrial robot workstations. It specifies guarding (fixed and interlocked guards, opening dimensions and safety distances), presence-sensing devices, interlock switching, fail-safe control and ancillary equipment, with approved laboratory testing for components.
key_provisions_or_claims: Fixed and interlocked guards must enclose the restricted robot work area, with opening sizes and safety distances in tables
Presence-sensing devices (light curtains, pressure mats) must stop automatic operation on intrusion
Interlock switching must fail safe, with redundant switches improving reliability
Restart after guard opening or intrusion must require deliberate resetting
Components such as safety devices must be approved by an authorised laboratory
